description: This PHP class `LegacyUserData` represents a data structure used for Google Sync migration within the SuiteCRM project. It defines properties related to user identification and token data in the context of migrating legacy user data for calendar synchronization.

classes.name: LegacyUserData
classes.description: A data structure class for storing legacy user data related to Google Sync migration, including user identifiers, token data, and connection status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializes the LegacyUserData object with user ID, username, full name, token data, optional refresh token, last connection status, and last connection test timestamp.
